_meta.purpose: Cloud/infra MCP servers useful at USER scope (available from any cwd), so cross-project skills reach them outside the FinalMindAI/quovy repo. aws-mcp and azure are ALSO defined in that repo's committed .mcp.json at project scope — project scope wins there; this user-scope copy is the fallback everywhere else.
_meta.schema: See personal.group.json _meta.schema. Optional `auth` drives `./install mcp auth`: {type:cmd, check:[argv], login:[argv]} runs check and fires login if it fails ($VARS expand from .env/env); {type:manual, instructions:str} just prints the step.
_meta.secrets_rule: Provided at launch by mcp/with-env from ../.env. Never inline a token.

aws-mcp._desc: AWS API access via the hosted aws-mcp proxy, read through the AWS_PROFILE credentials.
aws-mcp._prereq: AWS_PROFILE (default quovy-readonly) set in .env and SSO-logged-in — automated by `./install mcp auth aws-mcp`.

azure._desc: Azure resource management via the official @azure/mcp server.
azure._prereq: Azure CLI signed in — automated by `./install mcp auth azure`.

auth.instructions: Run /mcp in Claude Code and complete the Datadog OAuth login (browser). Non-US1 sites: swap the host in the manifest (e.g. mcp.datadoghq.eu).

datadog._desc: Official Datadog hosted MCP server (US1). Auth via OAuth.
datadog._prereq: OAuth via /mcp in Claude Code — cannot be scripted (Claude Code owns the handshake).

auth.instructions: Run /mcp in Claude Code and complete the Sentry OAuth login (browser).

sentry._prereq: OAuth via /mcp in Claude Code — cannot be scripted (Claude Code owns the handshake).

auth.instructions: Run /mcp in Claude Code and complete the Linear OAuth login (browser).

auth.instructions: The hosted GitHub MCP rejects Claude Code's OAuth dynamic client registration, so it needs a Personal Access Token in a Bearer header, exported into the shell that launches Claude Code (http headers bypass mcp/with-env). Steps: 1) github.com → Settings → Developer settings → Personal access tokens → generate a fine-grained token with the repo scopes you need. 2) Store in 1Password + add to your shell rc: export GITHUB_MCP_PAT=$(op read 'op://<vault>/github-mcp/token'). 3) ./install mcp get --force github, restart Claude Code + /mcp.

github._desc: GitHub hosted MCP server (repos, issues, PRs, Actions). Auth via a PAT Bearer header (OAuth DCR unsupported).
github._prereq: Requires GITHUB_MCP_PAT exported in the launching shell (see auth.instructions). Not auto-connected until the token exists.

auth.instructions: Run /mcp in Claude Code and complete the Notion OAuth login (browser).

notion._desc: Notion hosted MCP server (pages, databases, search). Auth via OAuth.
notion._prereq: OAuth via /mcp in Claude Code — cannot be scripted (Claude Code owns the handshake).

auth.instructions: Header-secret server (no OAuth). LANGFUSE_PROD_MCP_AUTH must be a base64 'publicKey:secretKey' string, exported into the shell that launches Claude Code (http headers are sent by Claude Code directly, NOT via mcp/with-env). Steps: 1) In Langfuse (langfuse.quovy.com) → Settings → API Keys, copy the public + secret key. 2) base64-encode 'PUBLIC:SECRET' (printf '%s' 'pk:sk' | base64). 3) Store it in 1Password and add to your shell rc: export LANGFUSE_PROD_MCP_AUTH=$(op read 'op://<vault>/langfuse-prod-mcp/credential'). 4) Re-register: ./install mcp get --force langfuse-prod, then restart Claude Code + /mcp.

langfuse-prod._desc: Langfuse (prod) hosted MCP server — LLM traces/observability. Auth via a Basic header token.
langfuse-prod._prereq: Requires LANGFUSE_PROD_MCP_AUTH exported in the launching shell (see auth.instructions). Not auto-registered until the token exists.
